critical_code_review_comments: Fairness contract holds: /daily/start and /daily/answer server replies never leak answer/explain/formula on the NEXT card (checked 31 payloads). The top-level answer/explain in an /answer reply correctly belongs to the card just answered (observed on reveal).

Server clock behaviour matches the spec: a card left past its 20 s is auto counted as timed_out so the lobby reopens at a LATER card after an away trip; a /finish counts the cards not reached as skipped (observed via F11 finishing at card 32).
One-try-a-day guard holds end-to-end: after rf-daily-finish, popup stops offering the round, the lobby CTA deep-links to the result, and a reload on the result screen stays on the result.
